(async()=>{ const tiles=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tile')]; tiles[0].querySelector('.fav').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); tiles[1].querySelectorAll('.stars button')[3].click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.querySelectorAll('.tile')[2].querySelectorAll('.stars button')[1].click(); return 'faved ' + tiles[0].title.split(/[\\/]/).pop() + ', rated ' + tiles[1].title.split(/[\\/]/).pop() + ' 4 stars'; })()

(async()=>{ [...document.querySelectorAll('.coll')].find(b=>/^All/.test(b.textContent.trim())).click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.lib-tools .seg button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='★').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.tile')].slice(0,3).map(t=>t.title.split(/[\\/]/).pop()).join(', ') + ' | saved meta: ' + Object.keys(__app.settings.meta||{}).length; })()
